posts.text: Disclosure: Invested Incorporated in 1989, Rashi Peripherals Limited is India’s leading ( #2 ) distributors of consumer technology, embedded/semiconductor products and enterprise solutions with a head office in Andheri (E), Mumbai. The company runs a pan-India distribution network covering 700+ locations, backed by 57 branches, 50 service centres and 73 warehouses. It partners with 80 global technology brands and serves over 10,250 channel partners, with a stated mission of making IT products available across all 800+ districts of India.
